decision.reason: Players and children both request a minimum capacity; trainers and cookies each satisfy at most one request whose requirement is no greater than their capacity. Version 2 of Assign Cookies explicitly supports 100,000 items per side, covering source 2410 while retaining its ID and all old inputs. Independent assignment-mask DP verifies 500 small inputs over the full value domain; nested-neighborhood deficiency bounds certify 100,000-item cases. The workbook sample maps players to g and trainers to s.

scale_oracle: Nested threshold neighborhoods: maximum matching equals requests minus largest capacity deficit
